node.title: E1 250-bit Pocklington exhibit field
node.statement: The displayed 250-bit integer p = 562949953421383 * 2^200 + 1 is prime by Pocklington, satisfies p < 2^256 and p = 1 mod 256, and supplies primitive roots of exact orders 128 and 256 for the E1 folded cells.
node.attack_surface: Pocklington arithmetic and displayed root-order checks for the common E1 exhibit field
node.falsifier: a failed Pocklington congruence/gcd check, p not prime, p not 1 mod 256, or a displayed root not having exact order 128 or 256
